summary: Birkenstock Holding plc filed a Form 6-K on May 13, 2026, furnishing a press release of its fiscal Q2 2026 results for the period ended March 31, 2026. The report discloses revenue of EUR 618 million (up 8% reported, 14% constant currency), gross margin of 53.9%, net profit of EUR 82 million (EPS EUR 0.45), and adjusted EBITDA of EUR 198 million. The company confirmed its full-year constant-currency revenue growth target of 13-15%. This is a routine earnings release containing ordinary financial and operational metrics; no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, or other special-situation event is announced.
